headers.im: Vangsawn lamkah a mael uh tih Judea kah Jews rhoek koep a thoh vaengah Esdras loh cabu pali a tael. Anih kah cabu a pacuek neh a pabae Ezra neh Nehemiah he Protestant long khaw, Roman Catholic long khaw, Jews rhoek long khaw boeih a pom. Esdras cabu rhoi he tah Jew rhoek kah Hebrew Bible dongah khaw, Protestant Bible dongah khaw thum pawh. Jerome kah a kong Latin Vulgate Bible (AD 404) dongah tah Esdras 1 (Ezra), Esdras 2 (Nehemiah), Esdras 3 la a khueh.

verses.text:
\s1 Josiah loh Yoom A Caak  
\r (2Mg 23. 21-23; 2Kh 35. 1-9)
Boeipa thangpomnah hamla Josiah loh Jerusalem ah Yoom a saii. Hla khat hnin hlai li vaengah tah khotue maeh te a ngawn uh.
Josiah loh khosoih rhoek te a coi tih hnin takuem Bawkim khuiah aitlaeng la thothueng ham, a himbai neh a thoeih cam.
Levi rhoek khaw, bawkim tueihyoeih rhoek khaw Boeipa bibi dongah amamih a cilpoe tih, David capa Solomon la a sak Boeipa Bawkim kah Paipi thingkawng cim te koh hamla ol a paek.

Josiah loh amih te hmuen khat lamloh hmuen khat la kawt uh voel boeh. Nangmih na Pathen Boeipa taengah tho aka thueng tih, a pilnam Israel kah bibi la na om uh. Imkhui neh koca loh na bibi te saii hamla sikim uh laeh.
Manghai David kah olpaek bangla a capa manghai Solomon long khaw a rhuepom la a saii. Israel pilnam ham Levi loh Boeipa bi a bi bangla na cako kah a hutnah te a thuem la bawkim ah a hmuen lo uh.
Yoom kah tuca neh mae te khaw ngawn uh lamtah na hui Israel ca ham hmueih te tawn uh. Te phoeiah Yoom te Boeipa loh Moses taengah uentonah a paek bangla saii uh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

Josiah loh pilnam aka thum rhoek taengah tu thawng sawmthum, maae ca thawng thum a paek. He tah pilnam teangah, khosoih taengah, Levi rhoek taengah ol a khueh bangla manghai im lamkah ni kutdoe la a paek.
Te vaengah bawkim aka hutnah boei rhoek tah, Hikiah, Zekhariah neh Heiel tih. Amih he khosoih la om tih tu thawng hnih yarhuk neh khotue kah hmueih la vaito ca yathum a paek.
Rhalboei rhoek la Conaniah, Shemaiah neh a mana Nethel, Hashabiah Cohiel neh Joram long khaw Levi rhoek kah hmueih a nawn ham tu thawng nga neh vaitoca yarhih te a paek.

Te vaengah amah he tlam he om van. Khosoih neh Levi rhoek loh amah a rhoep la phuekhlak uh tih vaidamding te a khuen uh. Mincang a pha vaengah tah Moses olkhueng kah a uen bangla Boeipa taengah nawnnah te a paek uh.
Amah imkhui neh koca kah boelnah bangla pilnam hmaiah a buhham te a khuen uh.
Levi rhoek loh Yoom hmuen te a hai uh tih am dongah a thong uh phoeiah baeldung dongah a bo a tui la a khueh uh.
Te phoeiah tah maeh te pilnam boeih hamla a tael pa uh. Te tlam te boeih a saii uh phoeiah tah maeh te amamih ham he Aaron cadil khosoih rhoek ham te a loh uh.
Khosoih rhoek he hlaem a pha hil hmueih kah a tha a phum tih mat tok uh.

Asaph koca Levi rhoek khuikah bawkim vongka aka tawt rhoek neh laasa rhoek tah manghai David kah uentonah bangla amah kah a hmuen ah om uh. Asaph, Zekhariah neh Eddinus amih he tah manghai yueng la om uh coeng.
Amih ham tah a tloe rhoek loh Yoom he a soepboe pah coeng dongah a paihmuen te nongtak ham ngoe pawh.
Manghai Josiahkah olpaek bangla Boeipa taengah nawn ham hmueih neh aka tukkai boeih te tah tekah khohnin ah a saii uh.
Yoom khotue khaw a bul uh tih hmueih te khaw hmueihtuk dongah a nawn uh.
Israel pilnam boeih tah Yoom tue vaengah thum uh tih vaidamding khotue te kha hnin rhih khuiah a yaeh uh.
Tonghma Samuel tue lamkah te Yoom he uepom la a saii uh moenih.
Lamhma kah Israel manghai rhoek khuiah khaw he tlam he Yoom aka saii pakhat khaw a om moenih.

He tah manghai Josiah loh a manghai nah kum hlai rhet vaengah Jerusalem aha s aii tih khosoih rhoek, Levi rhoek khaw, Judah neh Israel pilnam boeih long khaw a bul puei.   
\s1 Josiah Manghai A Bawtnah
Bawknah dongah a dung la a om dongah, Josiah kah a saii boeih te Boeipa loh a uem pah.

Tedae yankah cabu long khaw a cil te a thui. Josiah a manghai vaengah Boeipa taengah aka tholh tih boekoek rhoek khaw om a tih. Amih te a tloe namtu neh ram lakah khaw tholh uh tih Boeipa tloelnah hno te a saii uh. Te dongah a laitloeknah te Israel pilnam soh khung a tlak pah.
He tlam he Josiah loh boeih a saii phoeiah tah, Egypt manghai loh Perath tuiva kah Carchemis ah tloek uh rhoi ham caem a khuen.
Anih te Josiah loh a paa sak ngawn dae Egypt manghai loh Josiah taengla ol a pat tih, “Judah manghai te caem la kan tloek mahpawh.

Boeipa Pathen nang tloek hamla n'tueih moenih. Ka caemtloeknah he tah Perath ah ni a om. Kai taengah Boeipa om, Boeipa loh kah n'cahawh coeng. Te dongah na lambong te bal puei laeh, Boeipa te oel boeh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.
Tedae Josiah loh a hnuk mael pawt tih, a leng te khaw balkhong sak pawh. Tonghma Jeremaih dong lamloh Boeipa kah a thui te hnatun ham a aal tih, tloek hamla ko a tam.
Megiddo kol ah caemtloek la cet van dae Egypt rhalboei rhoek loh amah te a tloek uh.
Manghai Josiah loh a sal rhoek te, “Caemtloek hmuen lamloh n'khuen uh laeh, rhaidaeng la ka hmalaem coeng,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*. Te dongah anih te caemtloek kah rhongpai lamloh vik a khueh uh.
Anih te leng a tloe a loh pa uh tih Jerusalem la a mael puei uh. Teah a duek dongah anih te boei kah phuel ah a up uh.

Judah pilnam boeih tah anih hamla nguekcoi uh.  
 Tonghma Jeremiah loh manghai Josiah te rhaengsaelung neh a rhaeng sae. Te te Israel khuiah khaw khosing la om coeng. A lu rhoek neh a yuu rhoek long khaw anih ham a nguekcoi uh vaengah hekah laa he a sak uh.

Hekah olka he Judah manghai rhoek kah khokhuen dongah a khueh. Josiah loh a saii boeih, a mingthen a dang khaw, olkhueng a yakimingnah khaw, lamhma kah a saii boeih khaw Israel neh Judah minghai rhoek kah khokhuen dongah a khoem.   
\b  
\s1 Judah manghai Joahaz
Judah rhoek loh Josiah capa Joahaz te a tuek uh tih a manghai la a khueh uh vaengah Joahaz tah kum kul kum thum lo coeng.
Anih loh Judah neh Jerusalem te a uk ngawn dae Egypt manghai loh anih te vik a khoe.
Te phoeiah cak talen yakhat, sui talen khat te mangmu la a thoh sak.
Egypt manghai loh Joahaz mana Joakim te Judea neh Jerusalem kah manghai la a khueh.

Te vaengah Joakim te boei la a pin dae a mana Zarakes loh a muk tih Egypt khui lamkah vawl a caeh puei.   
\s1 Judah manghai Joakim
Joakim he kum kul kum nga a lo ca vaengah Judae neh Jeruslaem a manghai tih Boeipa kah mikhmuh ah a thae ni a saii.
Te vaengah anih Babylon manghai Nabuchodonosor loh anih te a paan tih rhohum rhui neh a khih phoeiah Babylon la a khuen.
Nabuchodonosor loh Boeipa kah hnopai te a loh tih a phueih phoeiah amah Babylon bawkim ah a khueh.

Tedae anih kah olthang khaw, a cim pawt neh a rhong khaw manghai rhoek kah khokhuencil dongah a kun sak.   
\b  
\s1 Judah manghai Jehoiakhin
Joakim yueng la a capa koep manghai tih, anih te manghai la a khueh uh vaengah kum hlairhet ni a lo ca pueng.
Anih te Jerusalem ah hla thum neh hnin rha manghai dae Boeipa mikhmuh ah boethae ni a saii.
Kum khat phoeiah tah nah Nabuchodonosor loh hlang tueih tih anih neh Boeipa kah honpai cim te Babylon la a loh sak.

Te phoeiah Sedekias te Judae neh Jerusalem kah manghai la a khueh. Te vaengah anih te kum kul kum khat lo ca pueng tih kum hlai khat tah manghai van.   
\s1 Judah manghai Zedekiah Jerusalem A Rhawpnah
Anih he khaw Boeipa mikhmuh ah a thae ni a saii. Jeremy dong lamloh Boeipa ol aka thoeng te khaw a ngaithuen moenih.

Boeipa ming neh Nabuchodonosor loh anih te a toemngam thil lamlong tah amah neh amah ta-aep nah coeng tih boe a koek coeng. A rhawn neh a thin a thah sak tih Israel Pathen Boeipa kah olkhueng te boeih a aek.
Pilnam kah khoboei rhoek neh khosoih rhoek loh boethae muep a saii uh.
A napa rhoek kah Pathen loh amih te hnuk mael khue ham a puencawn a tueih. Boeipa long tah amah omnah hmuen dongah thinphoei lungvatnah a khueh.
Boeipa loh amih a voek hnin ah khaw puencawn rhoek te a lawn uh tih tonghma te khaw a ho uh.
A pilnam te a thae rhoekoe caih coeng dongah amih neh a tingtawk la amih taengah Khalden manghai rhoek te a tueih pah.
Te long te cadong rhoek a bawkim cim kaepvai ah tumca neh a rhaih pah. Ca dong hula khaw tloe pawh, patong camoe khaw tloe pawh, Khalden rhoek kah kut dongah boeih a voeih.
Boeipa kah hopai cim boeih tah a yol a len khaw, Boeipa thingkawng dongkah hnopai khaw, manghai kah khohrhang khaw Babylon ka bat a khueh.
Boeipa im te khaw a hlup uh tih Jerusalem vongtung khaw a tulh uh phoeiah, a imsang khaw hmai neh a hoeh pa uh.
Thangpomnah hnopai boeih te a boeih hil a hmai mueh la a khueh uh. Pilnam tah tumca neh ngawn mueh la Babylon la a khuen.
Persian kah uknah tue a pha hil a ca rhoek khaw a taengah sal la om uh tih Jeremiah ka dong lamloh aka thoeng Boeipa ol te soep.
Khohmuen loh a Sabbath a uem hlan hil, kum sawmrhih khuiah tah Sabbath a tuem ham khaw a tue boeih tal uh.
Persia manghai Cyrus kah a kum khat nah dongah tah Jeremiah ka dong lamkah Boeipa ol aka thoeng te soep.
Boeipa loh Persia manghai Cyrus kah mueihla te a cahoeh pah. Te dongah a ram tom ah olhoenah a khueh tih a daek pah.
Persian manghai Cyrus tah Isarael kah Boeipa, Khohni Boeipa loh diklai pum kah manghai la kai n'khueh coeng.
Judaea kah Jerusalem kah im pakhat sak hamla ol m'paek coeng.

Pakhat khaw a pilnam la aka om boeih tah Boeipa te a Boeipai la om saeh lamtah a taengah om puei saeh. Anih te Judaea kah Jerusalem la caeh sak saeh lamtah Israel Boeipa kah im te sa saeh. Amah tah Jerusalem ah aka om Boeipa pai ni.
Te dongah Khotom rhali kah aka om boeih long khaw, amah kho ham tah sui neh, cak neh rhip bom uh saeh.
Kutdoe nen khaw, marhang nen khaw, saelhung neh khaw, te phoeiah Jerusalem kah Boeipa im ham olhlo nen khaw ka thap coeng lah ko,” a ti.

Te vaengah Judah imkhui neh Benjamin koca kah a lu khaw pai uh coeng. khosoih rhoek khaw, Levi rhoek khaw, Jerusalem kah Boeipa im aka sa la caeh ham te, Boeipa loh amih kah mueihla boeih a cahoeh pah coeng.

Te dongah a kaepvai kah khosak rhoek loh amih te a cungkuem la, cak neh, sui neh, marhang neh, saelhung neh a bom uh. A lungbuei a cahoeh pah rhoek hlangmi khaw a yet dongah a olhlo bangla kutdoe khaw muep yet.
Manghai Cyrus long khaw Boeipa im kah umam koep a thak. Te tah Nabuchodonosor loh Jerusalem kah loh tih mueirhol bawkim ah vik a khueh te ni.
Te vaengah Persian manghai Cyrus loh te rhoek te a loh tih tangka khoem Methradate kut a paek.
Anih long khaw Judaea khoboei Sanabassar kut ah a paek.
Te rhoek boeih te a pum la sui boengloeng thawng khat, cakben boengloeng thawng khat, cak tha om pakul pako, sui bunang sawmthum, cak te thawng hnih yali parha neh a tloe baelyak te thawngkhat lo.
Te dongah sui neh ca a khuen boeih te thawng nga yali sawm rhuk pako lo.

Te tah Sanabassar loh tamna rhoek neh Babylon lamloh Jerusalem la a mael puei.   
\s1 Jerusalem Thoh Ham Vaengah Tloelhnah

Persian manghai Artaxerxes tue vaengah Belemus, Mithradates, Tablelius, Rathumus, Beeltethum long khaw, cadaekung Samellius neh amih te a bong uh tih Samaria neh a tloe hmuen kah khosa rhoek loh Judaea neh Jurusalem kah kawng te a dangkah bangla ca a pat uh.
Cil aka khoem Rathumus khaw, cadaekung Samellius khaw, a tloe khoboei rhoek khaw, Coelesyria neh Phoenicia kah laitloekung rhoek khaw na sal boeih ni.

Ka boei manghai taengah khaw mingphanah om pawn saeh. Nang taeng lamloh kaimih taengla aka lo Judah rhoek tah Jerusalem la ha pai uh coeng. Boekoek neh halang tih khopuei thoh ham a saii uh. Hnoyoih hmuen neh vongtung khaw a tlaih uh tih, bawkim kah khoengim khaw a up coeng.
Khopuei te a thoh uh tih vong te khaw a khah uh coeng. Mangmu paek ham a aal uh vetih manghai tloelh ham pai uh pawn ni.
Te phoeiah he bang hno he bawkim khuila kun tih a kut dongah om uh coeng. He bang he sawtsut ham moenih tila ka poek uh.
Te ka manghai boeipa taengah thui ham neh, na ngai ham khaw tueng. Na huem bal atah na pa rhoek kah cabu dongah khaw so nawn.
Khokhuencil dongah hekah olka adaek te khaw so nawn. He khopuei he boe a koek uh dongah manghai neh khopuei rhoek a patang sak te khaw ming nawn.
Judah rhoek he boekoek rhoek ni, a rhuem tue vaengah khaw rhal la thoo uh. Te dongah ni khopuei khaw imrhong la a yalh sak.

Te dongah ni ka boei manghai taengah kan yaak sak. Khopuei te thoh tih vong te a thai la tung koini, tahae lamkah long tah Coelesyria neh Phoenica la pawnhlainah om voel mahpawh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.
Te dongah manghai loh Cil aka khoem Rathumus khaw, cadaekung Samellius khaw, a tloe khoboei rhoek khaw, Coelesyria neh Phoenicia kah laitloekung rhoek khaw a dangkah bangla ca koep a pat.
Kai ham ca nan pat uh te ka tae ngawn coeng. Te dongah khenah khueh hamla ol ka paek coeng. Te vaengah, khopuei he a rhuem ah khaw manghai taengah boekoeknah a khueh te a hm uh.
Boekoek neh rhal la a thoh uh dongah Coelesyria neh Phoenicia aka uk tih mangmu aka lo manghai hlang tlung rhoek loh Jerusalem ah thinsanah a khueh uh.
Te dongah ol ka paek coeng lah ko. Khopuei aka sa hlang rhoek te khaw khoep mah uh tih. He ol neh kingkalh pakhat khaw saii pawt ham ngaithuen saeh.
Tebang halang bii aka saii rhoek loh manghai te ngae-lawn boel saeh,” a ti.

Manghai Artaxerxes kah a capat te a tae van neh, Rathumus, cadaek Samellius, a mih taengkah a rhoi boeih te a marhang neh, pilnam hlangping neh Jerusalem la koeloe thoeih uh tih, imsa rhoek te paa sak ham caemtloekneh rhong a pai. Te dongah Jerusalem bawkim kah a sak uh te khaw Persian manghai Darius kah a manghainah a kumbae hil paa uh.   
\b
Manghai Darius loh a sal boeih ha, a im kah a cun boeih ham neh Media Persia kah mangpa boeih hamla khotue kueng a saii pah.
Te vaengah boeilu khaw, rhalboei khaw, a hmui kah khoboei khaw, India lamloh Ethiopia hil ram ya pakul parhih lo uh.
A caak, a ok uh tih a hah uh phoeiah tah im la mael uh. Manghai Darius khaw a imkhan la cet tih ip dae a ih kung lamloh haenghang.
Te vaengah kanghai aka tawt pum-oep hlang cadong pathum te khat neh khat voek uh thae.
Mamih kah ming he pae sih lamtah diklai hmankah aka khuet koek ming la khueh sih. He oldawtnah he a cui la a hlat tah kutdoe a len koek pae saeh lamtah tanah te khaw dang saeh.

Boeimang himbai te bai saeh lam tah sui boengloeng dongah o saeh. Sui thingkong dongah yalh saeh. A leng te khaw sui ngoldoelh kamrhui la om saeh. Hnitang lupong te khaw muei saeh lamtah, a sui oi te oi saeh.
A cueih van bangla anih te manghai kah baerhoep la om saeh. Manghai kah paya tila thangpomnah mingthen kaw pae saeh,” a ti uh.
Te dongah a poek thai khuila hlatnah a then te a daek uh tih manghai kah luhoe hmuiah a khueh. Te vaengah khat neh khat te,
“Manghai a haenghang vaengah tah ol he a taengah pae saeh. Amah neh Persia kah boei rhoek loh a cueih koek la hlatnah te pae saeh. A ta long tah a cadaek soah kutdoe te pae saeh,” a ti uh.
Lamhma loh, “Yu lakah tha aka om he om pawh,” tila a daek.
A pabae loh, “Manghai lakah tha aka om he om pawh,” a ti bal.
A pathum loh, “Huta lakah tha aka om he om pawh, tedae oltak long tah mebang khaw a ta,” tila a daek.
Manghai a haenghang vaengah tah ol a daek uh te a taengla a paek tih a tae.
Te dongah puencawn a tueih tih Persia neh Media kah boeilu rhoek khaw, boeiham rhoek khaw, taemkung khaw, khoboei khaw, caeltueih rhoek khaw tun a khue.
Oltunnah hmuen kah ngolhmuen a loh phoeiah tah ol pathum te tha-ue la a tae.
“Cadong pathum te hang khuen lamtah a hlatnah te thuicaih uh saeh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*. Te dongah a taengla a khuen pa uh van.
Me bang a daek uh te khaw a thuicaih uh.
Yu kawng aka daek cadong long te lamhma la a thui tih, “Hinyah kap rhoek, yu he diklai hman ah tha aka om koek tihe phaeng m'ming coeng. Te aka om boeih tah a lungbuei boeih a hmaang sak coeng.
Hlang boeih soah khaw, manghai neh cadah soah khaw, sal neh sayalh taengah khaw, boei neh khodaeng soah khaw vanat lam ni a om.
Hlang boeih a omngaih sak tih a yalpo sak, kothae neh a bitat khaw a hnilh sak,
hlang boeih boei bangla a ngai sak tih manghai neh mangpa kah saithainah khaw a hnoelrho sak. Diklai pum he khaw amah kah bangla boeih a thui sak.
Yu o hlang rhoek loh a paya neh imben khaw a hmaai sak. Te dongah cunghang a yueh uh tih ngawn uh thae.
A caih uh vaengah tah mebang a saii uh khaw ming uh voel pawh.
Hinyah kap rhoek aw, yu loh he tlam a saii coeng atah, yu he diklai hmanah tha aka om koek rhep coeng ni,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.
Manghai kah thaomnah aka daek long khaw koe thui van tih,
“Hinyah kap rhoek aw, hlang lakah tha aka om koek he diklai hmanah a om moenih. Hlang long he diklai neh tuitunli sokah aka om boeih khaw, diklai hman ka a cungkuem soah khaw a uktaem ta.
Tedae te rhoek boeih lakah khaw manghai he a tha-om koek. Manghai tah amih kah boeipa neh a kungmah la om. Hlang loh anih ol a ngai pah, mebang ol a thui mai a khaw.
Amih te caemtloeknah saii ti nah koinih a saii uh mai. Amih te caemrhal taengla tueih cakhaw cet uh mai coeng. Tlang khaw, pangbueng, imsang khaw phil a ti nah ca khaw, a saii uh mai.

Amih te ngawn ti mai cakhaw a ngawn mai coeng. Manghai kah olpaek aka aal he a om moenih. Tanah a dang uh vaengah khaw a kutbuem boeih te manghai ham a khuen pah. Caemtloek vaengah a dang boeih te khaw a khaw a khueh pah.
Lotawn khaw caemtloek la a caeh pawt atah, a cangah boeih te manghai taengla a thak coeng. Pakhat loh a hui khaw manghai taengah mangmu paek hamla a tanolh coeng.
Manghai amah bueng he hlang la a om coeng. Pilnam te ngawn saeh a ti atah a ngawn uh mai. Thongtla rhoek te loeih saeh a ti atah a loeih sak uh mai.
Amih te tloek saeh a ti atah a tloek uh mai. Amih te phae saeh a ti atah a phae uh mai. Im sa a ti atah a sak u mai hoeh.
Khohmuen cangvuei te phae ham neh phung ham a thui akhaw a rhoi uh mai.
Hlang boeih, rhalkap long khaw, rhaengpuei long khaw manghai ol te a ngai uh. Anih te caak ham ok ham a ngol vaengah khaw, a ih thuk ah khaw.
A taengom rhoek loh a taeng rhawp a tawt, anih ol te a ngaih pawt tah, hlang loh amah ngaih la cet tih amah bi te a bi thai moenih.

Hinyah kap rhoek aw, he tlam ni pilnam loh manghai ol a ngai. Te dongah anih lakah tha aka om he diklai ah om pawh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.   
\s2 Huta Kawng Thuinah
Te phoeiah a pathumnah ah, huta neh oltak kawng aka thui he, Jerubbable ni.
Anih long he atong tih, “Hinyah kap rhoek, manghai he a leng moenih, hlang khaw a yet moenih, yuu khaw a tha a om moenih. A soah uh lae aka om pueng, ulong te te a uk? Te tah huta moenih a?
Lan neh tuitunli soah aka boei manghai neh pilnam boeih he huta long ni a sak.
Amih te huta dong lamkah a thoeng. Yu la than ham misur kung aka tue hlang boeih khaw huta long ni a cun.
Huta loh hang ham himbai a tah, hlang thangpomnah khaw a saii, huta a om pawt atah hlang khaw a om thai moenih.
Tongpa long sui khaw, cak khaw, hnothen khaw a kol mai khaming. Suisak a hlang aka huta te a hmuh vaengah tah, tekah hno khaw boeih khum van.
A taengah longhoi om tih a taengah a ka a ang. Te dongah sui khaw, cak khaw, a tloe hnothen boeih khaw anih ham ni a om coeng.
Tongpa loh amah anih aka cun ana pa khaw, a khohmuen khaw a toeng tih a yuu taengla kap mai hoeh.
A khohnin khaw a yuu taengah a thok sak tih, a napa khaw, a manu khaw, a khohmuen khaw a poeknah om voel pawh.

Te dongah huta loh nang soah boei a bi te poek.
